risk.rationale: F1 confirms suspicious sign-ins from Cloudvault VPS (DE) outside the account baseline (T1078.004), but this alone is not a confirmed account-takeover chain. F3 confirms exposure: VPN appliance vpn-edge-01 runs CISA KEV-listed software with multiple exploited vulnerabilities (T1190/T1133). Separately, the DQ conflict (vpn_session_order failing on vpn-edge-01) makes the VPN session evidence unreliable/conflicting. Per policy, confirmed exposure plus conflicting/insufficient evidence requires human review rather than automated contain. F1 and F3 are both CONFIRMED findings supporting escalation over the alternative contain call.
